reason: The commit only hardens the existing json_vsprintf implementation by handling a negative vsnprintf result and using size_t for allocation and formatting sizes. It introduces no new entry point, feature, protocol, initialization requirement, configuration, or input constraint. The existing json_loadb/json_dumps/json_dump_callback harness remains adequate for the paths it was designed to exercise; this unrelated implementation fix does not itself require harness maintenance.
evidence: json_vsprintf now exits through out when vsnprintf(NULL, 0, fmt, ap) returns length < 0.
The jsonp_malloc and second vsnprintf size arguments are changed from length + 1 to (size_t)length + 1.
The public function signature and calling requirements of json_vsprintf are unchanged.
The harness continues to control load_flags, dump_flags, dump_mode, and JSON input while invoking json_loadb followed by json_dumps or json_dump_callback.
No new API, state, configuration flag, or source entry point appears in the production diff.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harness unchanged; no maintenance is justified by this commit.
